Personality: Kinvara is calm and fiery, viewing the faith of the Lord of Light as a force capable of illuminating the darkness of Slaver's Bay. Combining compassion with authority, she is willing to succor the weak and unafraid to shatter the old order through fear.
Background: Kinvara is a red priestess from Volantis who entered Daenerys's sphere of influence through faith and prophecy. She is well versed in the slave systems, port politics, and priestly networks of the Free Cities. To the common folk, she may be a protector; to the old slave masters, she resembles a fire that cannot be bought off with gold.
